recipe.visualDefinition: A central rectangular photograph of a man in a dark suit standing amidst a massive pile of faceted diamonds, framed by a wide, textured blue border containing ultra-thin, geometric display typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the organic human form and the sharp, crystalline texture of the diamonds
Hierarchy established by the large-scale hairline title text against the solid blue header
Framing effect of the thick blue border enclosing the high-key central image
Visual link between the man's gaze and the diamond held aloft
coreInvariants: Ultra-thin hairline stroke weight for primary titles
Solid, slightly desaturated blue framing border
High-contrast studio lighting on the central figure
Dense, sparkling texture in the lower third of the inner frame

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure occupies the middle vertical axis, scaled to fit within the inner white-background rectangle.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man's face and the diamond he holds create a focal point in the upper half of the inner frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large hairline title, move down to the subject's face, follow his arm to the diamond, and settle on the pile of gems below.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space provided by the solid blue border and the white studio background behind the subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Medium-dark blue (border and background for text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white inner frame and the blue outer frame; low saturation in the central image except for skin tones.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to blue, white, and naturalistic tones for the subject.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely high aspect ratio (tall and narrow)
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'J' has a wide, shallow hook
The 'R' features a straight diagonal leg starting from the vertical stem
The 'U' is perfectly U-shaped with no tail
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying weights and widths of the same geometric sans-serif family.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: ITC Avant Garde Gothic Extra Light
candidateDirections.reason: Captures the geometric 70s soul aesthetic and circular 'O's
Provides the necessary geometric skeleton and sharp points

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A man in a 1960s dark olive suit standing in a waist-high pile of sparkling, faceted diamonds against a plain white studio background. The entire image is framed by a thick, textured medium-blue border with a large empty space at the top for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a large, white, hairline geometric sans-serif font at the top. Add secondary text in a smaller, wider-tracked version of the same font below it. Ensure all text is centered within the blue header area.

verificationChecks: Is the title font extremely thin?
Is the central image framed by a solid blue border?
Are the diamonds rendered with high-contrast sparkle?
Is the text perfectly centered horizontally?

avoid: Heavy or bold fonts in the header

postGenerationChecks: Verify the blue border has a subtle vintage paper texture.
Ensure the man's pose is dignified and focused on the diamond.
Check that the hairline font is legible against the blue background.
Confirm the diamonds appear as a physical pile the subject is standing in.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central subject + thematic texture (diamonds/ice) + high-key background + thick colored border + hairline geometric typography.
